description: Table 5 and the additional bearing table. Replayed bearing histories: each FEMTO bearing is evaluated by models, classifiers and rules fitted without its outer fold, and the XJTU-SY bearings by models, classifiers and rules fitted on all FEMTO bearings and applied unchanged. One step is one minute, and the recorded test end is the last productive minute.

folds.derivation: Sort the bearings by the SHA-256 hex digest of 'bearings_when_to_act_v1|bearing_folds|<dataset>|<bearing>' and assign the sorted rank modulo 5. The dataset string is 'femto' for the outer folds, 'femto|inner|outer<f>' for the inner folds of outer fold f and 'femto|inner|transfer' for the fit on all FEMTO bearings.
folds.use: Within the training set of each outer fold, the inner folds supply out-of-fold forecasts for PPO training and rule calibration; the last inner split serves the fit on all FEMTO bearings for the transfer.

forecast_rule_fitting.order_when: the design's forecast of the remaining minutes <= theta, read from its forecast input clip(forecast / 125, 0, 1.2) <= theta / 125 in float32
forecast_rule_fitting.fitted: highest pooled calendar profit on the training bearings of the outer fold (FEMTO) or on all FEMTO bearings (XJTU-SY); exact ties keep the smallest theta

Risk classifier: Full.inputs: the seven policy inputs of PPO: Full on the same training and evaluation bearings
Risk classifier: Full.model: scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingClassifier(learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=300, max_leaf_nodes=15, min_samples_leaf=20, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=False, random_state=0)
Risk classifier: Full.labels: 1 for every minute at or after the last safe order T - 12, else 0, with weight 1/T per minute so that every training bearing has equal weight
Risk classifier: Full.order_when: first minute whose score is at least theta
Risk classifier: Full.fitted: theta from 0.01 to 0.99 in steps of 0.01 with the highest pooled calendar profit on leave-one-bearing-out scores of the training bearings, the smallest theta in a tie; the classifier is then refitted on all training bearings, taken in the order of their names

Risk classifier: No age.inputs: the six policy inputs of PPO: No age on the same training and evaluation bearings
Risk classifier: No age.order_when: first minute whose score is at least theta

Forecast rule: No age.forecast: the forecaster of PPO: No age

Indicator Rule.families: age, RMS level, peak level, forecast, and forecast plus trend. A level is the larger of the two channels' logarithms of RMS or peak over the bearing's own running-in median, exponentially smoothed with weight k on the newest minute. The trend is the least-squares slope of the forecast over the latest ten minutes. The rule orders at the first minute that meets its condition.
Indicator Rule.fitted: highest pooled calendar profit on the training bearings (the outer training set for FEMTO, all FEMTO bearings for XJTU-SY)

Reactive.order_when: never; every bearing runs to its recorded end
